serverInfo.title: Agent Discovery Doctor
serverInfo.description: See which discovery files a host serves - llms.txt, agent card, mcp.json. Free, no key, no signup. Names the validators observed asking for each one, says what a 404 costs, and validates or drafts the documents from pasted text. Call whoami first: no arguments at all, and it answers about the request you just sent. example is the other zero-argument tool — it runs a worked answer.
